narr: Remnant outflow boundaries from the previous day's storms resulted in scattered convective development. A moist and unstable atmosphere combined with the previous day's rainfall created a perfect opportunity for showers and strong thunderstorms with hail, damaging wind, and flash flooding.
ev: Flash flooding reported on US-412 and on Buttercup Lane in Paragould.
lsr: CORRECTS PREVIOUS FLASH FLOOD REPORT FROM 1 ESE PARAGOULD. FLASH FLOODING ON US-412.
